e3aec2df59.rewrite:
vmovdqu64 YMMWORD PTR [rdi],ymm16
lea r8,[r8+rdi*1]
and rdi,0xffffffffffffffe0
sub r8,rdi
lea rdi,[rdi+0x20]
sub r8,0x80
e3aec2df59.why: Adding the original pointer and subtracting its aligned value adds exactly its low five bits to r8. The pointer advance is equivalent modulo 64 bits, and the unchanged final subtraction receives the same value and preserves CF.

e8cc36ec89.rewrite:
vshufi64x2 zmm17,zmm16,zmm16,0x44
vmovdqu64 ZMMWORD PTR [rdi],zmm17
vmovdqu64 ZMMWORD PTR [rdi+0x40],zmm17
add rdi,0x80
sub r8,0x80
e8cc36ec89.why: The shuffle duplicates the low 256 bits of zmm16 into both halves of a scratch register, so two unaligned 512-bit stores write exactly the original 128 bytes and values. The pointer and count updates, CF, and full zmm16 value are preserved.
